notes: The controller has been optimized for the new geometry, focusing on reducing line loss events and improving tracking accuracy.
rationale: The previous race telemetry indicated a high line loss event count (5 events) and a significant RMS error (0.2). To improve performance, I have integrated a controller that adjusts the base speed and PID parameters to enhance tracking. The controller is designed to work with the new geometry, which has a narrower body and larger sensors. I expect these changes to reduce line loss events and improve overall tracking accuracy.
